comparison: Exact original50-step canonical controls must match history,exported weights,teacher and complete merged answers before any accepted-set fit. Accepted-set changes only the five initially accepted auxiliary rows per full-size case, using existing reference aliases and the original canonical-length denominator. The two auxiliary base/reference disagreements use identical canonical CE in both arms. Targets, supports,learning rates,orders,step count,clipping,scaling and optimizer are fixed.
gradient_observer: Read-only cumulative-gradient snapshots after target and auxiliary backward; unscale,then subtract to measure auxiliary contribution before global clipping. Floating accumulation rounding remains. This is a mediator diagnostic,not an independent auxiliary-only backward or exact attribution to an EOS feature. Both canonical controls include the observer and must retain exact original histories.
primary_causal_prediction: At least two of three representations,including selected paired neurons,halve case1 P(subscript2 | oxygen prompt,O) versus their canonical endpoint while retaining all4/4 transfer answers in both cases and preserving/restoring the oxygen answer O. This supports the auxiliary-loss hypothesis on these development cases,not practical adaptation superiority.
practical_requirements: Report all complete-answer gains/losses,truncations,refusals,accepted mass and wrong-continuation competition. A useful candidate still needs8/8 transfers,no new genuine greedy preservation errors and the unchanged0.02 probability-drop target on eligible probes.
